title: Do LLM-Judge Biases Compose? Code, pilot data, and pre-registration for a label-free test of the position x verbosity interaction (SSIT / IASC)
description:
Reference implementation, gold-free real-judge pilot data, and frozen analysis pipeline for the paper Do LLM-Judge Biases Compose? A Label-Free Test for the Position x Verbosity Interaction.

LLM-as-a-judge pipelines correct position, verbosity and self-preference bias sequentially, assuming the biases add. This artifact accompanies: (1) a proposition that if position and verbosity bias interact, fitting the corrections marginally leaves a residual of ½|β_PV|; (2) SSIT, a label-free difference-in-differences over the four position×verbosity swap cells that identifies β_PV, with a simulation characterising when its identifying assumption holds; (3) IASC, a partial label-free correction of the position-coupled bias subspace; and (4) a 7-judge / 6-family pilot plus a pre-registered protocol.

Contents

  • ssit.py — Swap-Symmetry Interaction Test.
  • sim_ssit_robustness.py — SSIT's readout vs. the judge's true population interaction across six decision rules, including a linkless threshold judge (bias ≤ 0.004, gold-free).
  • sim_ssit_power.py — power of the SSIT wild-cluster test vs. number of pairs, samples/cell, and judge decisiveness; analyze_real.py also reports a design-based realized power per judge.
  • iasc.py — Interaction-Aware Swap Correction (partial, label-free; under-corrects by a data-dependent amount).
  • ia_ppi.py — a valid-CI variant via post-stratified prediction-powered inference.
  • sim_prop2_coverage.py — PPI coverage under cell-composition shift. sim_ranking_impact.py — downstream cost: leaderboard Kendall-tau recovery and an RLHF preference-label-flip upper bound from an uncorrected interaction.
  • analyze_real.py, analyze_iasc.py, analyze_iappi.py — frozen analysis of the pilot data.
  • collect_free.py — multi-provider free-tier judgment collector (13 model families).
  • data/raw/ — pilot judgments from seven judges (gpt-oss-20b/120b, gemma, qwen3-27b, allam-2-7b, mistral-small, command-r) across all eight (P,V,S) swap cells; data/raw_padded/ + make_padded_v.py — a length-only (padding, not paraphrase) verbosity re-test for four judges (mistral-small, command-r, qwen3-27b, allam-2-7b).
  • paper_neurips_workshop.pdf, paper_neurips_workshop.tex — the manuscript.

Dependencies: numpy, scipy (requests for the collector; others only for the legacy figure pipeline). Seed 2024 throughout.
notes: Accompanies a submission to the Workshop on the Evaluation of LLMs as Judges (JUDGe) at NeurIPS 2026 (non-archival). An earlier version was reviewed at ICMLA 2025 (not published). Non-simulation results are Propositions 1-5 and the pilot's interaction pattern (i_PV, and the P x V / P x S vs. V x S split); all other quantitative magnitudes are simulation-based.
